comment: priest.c priest_talk() 'Thy selfless generosity is deeply appreciated.' after a protection donation that does not raise u.ublessed (704-705). A gnomish Healer in debug mode builds minetn-7 with #wizloaddes, maps it and teleports beside the neutral altar, wishes 6000 gold and donates the larger suggested amount twice: the first (12 times the base) raises u.ublessed past 9, and the second (4 times) leaves it unchanged under rn2(u.ublessed).
